write.listing_copy: Stunning custom-built home featuring modern amenities and spacious layouts. Located in a quiet neighborhood with easy access to shopping and dining. This property offers energy-efficient appliances, updated fixtures, and a beautiful backyard perfect for entertaining. The open-concept living areas create a welcoming atmosphere, while the master suite provides privacy and comfort. Additional features include a two-car garage, fully fenced yard, and recent renovations throughout. A true gem in the community, this home combines style and functionality. Contact us today for your private showing!
